existing.description: Maastricht University awards one full-coverage scholarship per academic year to a bachelor student who has been admitted to its Global Studies bachelor's programme. For 2027-2028 the award covers tuition fees at cost plus a living-expense stipend of EUR 20,150 per academic year, and includes a mandatory two-week UM Pre-Academic Training in the first week of August 2027. Applications are open from 1 October 2026 to 1 February 2027, and the bachelor's programme application in Studielink must be complete by 10 December 2026.
eligibility: Nationality of an OECD DAC-eligible country, Surinam excluded
No dual nationality with an EU/EEA country, Switzerland or Surinam
Able to obtain an entry visa and residence permit for the Netherlands
Applicant to the Global Studies bachelor's programme at Maastricht University for 2027-2028, file complete before 10 December 2026
Meets the specific admission requirements of the bachelor programme applied to
Does not hold a diploma from a higher education institution and has not completed a bachelor-equivalent degree
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold the nationality of an OECD Official Development Assistance eligible country (excluding Surinam), must not hold dual EU/EEA, Swiss or Surinamese nationality, must have applied for admission to the Global Studies bachelor's programme for 2027-2028 with a complete file before 10 December 2026, must not already hold a bachelor's-equivalent degree, and must be under 35 years of age on 1 September 2027.
benefits: EUR 20,150 per academic year for living expenses, broken down by Maastricht as housing EUR 960, groceries and personal hygiene EUR 160, telephone EUR 60, travel EUR 100, books and study materials EUR 90, clothing, hobbies and going out EUR 125, miscellaneous EUR 55
A UM room allocated to the scholar until 16 July 2028
Two-week mandatory UM Pre-Academic Training in the first week of August 2027
Participation in the International Student Ambassador Programme
coverage: Tuition fees for the Global Studies bachelor's programme, at cost per academic year
Living expenses of EUR 20,150 per academic year (EUR 1,550 per month)
Health and liability insurance, at cost
UM Pre-Academic Training costs, at cost
International Student Ambassador Programme (ISAP) costs for the first block only
requirements: Apply for the Global Studies bachelor's programme at Maastricht University via Studielink and receive a UM student ID before applying for the scholarship
Complete all registration requirements by 1 February 2027, except legal residence, tuition payment and a hard copy of the diploma
Pay any programme handling fee yourself by 10 December 2026; the scholarship does not cover it
Sign and return the award letter to the UM International Services Desk to accept the scholarship
Agree to act as an active Global Studies and UM ambassador during and after the studies, including at least one information session
documents: Curriculum vitae, maximum two A4 pages, covering education, job experience, extracurricular engagement and active citizenship
Letter of motivation using the UM template
Proof of academic excellence: latest grade transcript showing at least 75% of the maximum grade
One reference letter dated no earlier than 1 February 2025, written by a professor, teacher, principal, college counsellor, lecturer or employer, not a family member
Contact details of the one referee, including relationship, work telephone number and work or institutional email address
application_method: Apply for admission to the Global Studies bachelor's programme through Studielink
Log in with your UM account on the UM scholarship application form
Upload the required documents and the reference letter, then submit once before the deadline
existing.selection_notes: The UM International Services Desk checks application completeness after 1 February 2027; the Global Studies admission office ranks files on the UM scholarship selection criteria and proposes a top five to the Global Studies Scholarship selection committee in March 2027; the top five are interviewed online; candidates are informed of their status in April 2027, with selected, waitlisted or rejected status final by the beginning of June 2027.
existing.best_fit: A student from an ODA-eligible country who has finished secondary school, applies to the Global Studies bachelor's programme at Maastricht, has demonstrable financial need and strong extracurricular and community engagement.
existing.notes: Only one application may be submitted and documents cannot be replaced afterwards. The scholarship portal is unavailable between 22 and 26 October 2026 during a portal upgrade. Refusing the allocated room cancels the scholarship. Air tickets and the approximately EUR 75 cleaning fee are not covered. The published amounts are stated as subject to change from academic year 2028-2029.
existing.duration: 36 months (the full three-year Global Studies bachelor's programme)
existing.application_period: 1 October 2026 - 1 February 2027 (scholarship form); bachelor programme application in Studielink by 10 December 2026
